@graph.name: Elenchon Atlas — Security
@graph.description: How Elenchon Atlas secures a cloud WPS register: a searchable history of every change, role-based access with a read-only inspector seat, single-tenant isolation, EU hosting, and encryption in transit.

mainEntity.name: Is my WPS data isolated from other customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Elenchon Atlas is single-tenant: your register and documents live in their own database and are never pooled with another shop's. It's the same isolation discipline as the on-premise Elenchon platform, applied to your cloud tenant.

mainEntity.name: Where is the data hosted, and is it encrypted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your tenancy runs on infrastructure located in the European Union, so your procedures and register stay within the jurisdiction you operate in. Traffic to your tenant is encrypted over TLS, your data is isolated to your tenancy alone, and access is yours to control down to a single read-only seat.

mainEntity.name: Can I give an inspector or a client read-only access without risk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Access is role-based — admins, editors and viewers — so you can hand your TÜV or notified-body inspector a read-only seat: full visibility, no ability to change anything. Editors change data; viewers can only look.

mainEntity.name: Is there a history of changes to the register?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every recompute, import, edit and verification is recorded with the user behind it and a timestamp, and the log is searchable, so “who changed this?” becomes a lookup rather than an investigation. You control how long the log and old versions are kept.
